interpretation_limits: A PASS is development evidence only; sealed holdout validation remains mandatory before promotion.
Every detector has exactly two spheres. The 11 detector spheres in the 10 ms sampler batch eight independent candidates plus current geometry efficiently.
The mesh is used only to place two simple spheres and enforce the 20 mm bottom-offset/proximity limits.
The primary profile supplies only FSM load/contact evidence; heel and forefoot sensor forces exclusively generate gait-event guards.
The operational 60 ms reference-noise diagnostic is secondary only and can never replace the strict 50 ms gate, select, or promote.
The 1 ms replay is forbidden without a strict 10 ms winner and evaluates only that winner plus current geometry.
No policy, training, rollout, runtime default, FSM, profile, or sealed data is modified or evaluated.
objective: Close the two residual both-off samples and two early toe-off candidates observed at H2/X+2/F80/P34 while preserving HS max 46.533 ms, TO max 42.011 ms, and full swing release. Keep the heel fixed and sweep only forefoot depth P34.25--P36.00.
